- GAME COMPLETE. Genuine authored ending reached: Florantine framed with the ring and hanged ("*** You have been hanged ***" as story progression), epilogue "In the Crowd, Below the Scaffold", final banner "Six o'clock comes, and conciousness fades. *** You rest ***" with RESTART/RESTORE/QUIT prompt (e00254). Finish action submitted as m0173.

## Full route summary
- Scaffold opening → Empty Room escape → Church/Vestry → Streets capture → Grand Staircase/Palace (enlistment, Florantine office) → Piazza pardon → Francesca → Resistance meeting → recapture → cell night → scaffold → Bedroom (woman, note naming Florantine as target) → inn → Palace replay with identity-blur ("strange sensation") → Florantine thrown into cell → ring planted on aide ("put ring on aide") → "enter giuseppe" merge → scaffold hanging of Florantine → epilogue → "*** You rest ***".

## Checkpoints (all verified saved)
- scaffold-opening, passage-hatch-barred, staircase-top, piazza-pardoned, bedroom-final-sequence, piazza-assassin-mission, cell-with-florantine

## Cases annotated (~24 total)
Vocabulary: get down→down; guiseppe→aide; guiseppe→giuseppe (talk, enter — walkthrough's own spelling fails twice); kis→kiss typo.
None (accepted variations): noose=rope; look at/x; put ring in bowl; give coin auto-take; tear paper; enter darkness (article omitted).
World_state: hands tied (take key); teeth dead-end→shard; talk to woman flees (wine stains); knock-before-sign; take candle (authority); drop/throw key refusal (authorial lock); read paper too dark→open blind; remove ring tied→freed; remove ropes mercy gate.
Planning: break bottle vs open wine; shout/untie/kick; put key in hoop after 'lock it' dead-end; kill florantine → put ring on aide (framing, not direct kill).

## Edition divergences (011119 story vs 010908 walkthrough)
- 'jump into darkness' unneeded at scaffold (auto-advance)
- 'take key' fails while tied (shard first)
- drop/throw key refused by design
- 'take candle' refused (authority); candle unnecessary
- 'talk to woman' with wine-stained legs makes her flee
- walkthrough spelling 'guiseppe' not recognised (2 instances)
- walkthrough 'remove ropes' in the cell refused ('too late for mercy'); framing via ring is the actual solution

## Notes for review
- Multiple keypress transitions used empty command string per menu protocol.
- The hanging scene (e00252 "*** You have been hanged ***") is story progression, NOT the ending; the authored conclusion is the crowd epilogue (e00253) + "*** You rest ***" (e00254).
